submission.justification: Mixture-G1 with a 2.0 mm gas gap achieves the best time resolution of 0.868 ns among all tested configurations. This configuration was identified through systematic simulation of all three candidate mixtures at gas gaps of 1 mm, 2 mm, and 3 mm, followed by fine-tuning around the optimal 2 mm gap for Mixture-G1 (testing 1.8, 1.9, 2.0, 2.1, and 2.2 mm). The 2.0 mm gap consistently delivered superior performance compared to neighboring gap values. Mixture-G1 significantly outperforms Mixture-G2 (1.28 ns at 2 mm) and Mixture-G3 (2.001 ns at 2 mm), making it the clear choice for achieving the best possible time resolution within the specified constraints.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible time resolution
requirements.evidence: Mixture-G1 at 2.0 mm gap achieves 0.868 ns time resolution, which is the best performance among all 11 simulations conducted across all three mixtures and various gap configurations.
